title: The Borderline Prediction Was Dropped
subject: AIML
briefing: A classifier converts predicted probabilities into binary labels. Scores at the configured decision threshold belong to the positive class.
symptom: Examples with a score exactly on the threshold are labeled negative.
hints: Look for a probability equal to the configured threshold.
The positive class includes the boundary value, not just values above it.
Compare each score using an inclusive greater-than-or-equal condition.
